cases.sentence: Ведь люди осквернили эту землю и жгли здесь благовония ___, которых не знали ни они сами, ни их отцы, ни цари Иудеи, и залили эту землю невинной кровью.
cases.explain: «чужим богам» — the dative marks the indirect object or recipient.
cases.translation: Because they have forsaken me, and have defiled this place, and have burned incense in it to other gods that they didn’t know, they, their fathers, and the kings of Judah, and have filled this place with the blood of innocents,

cases.sentence: Я повергну их мечом перед врагами руками тех, кто хочет их смерти, и отдам их трупы в пищу ___ и земным зверям.
cases.explain: «небесным птицам» — the dative marks the indirect object or recipient.
cases.translation: “ ‘ “I will make the counsel of Judah and Jerusalem void in this place. I will cause them to fall by the sword before their enemies, and by the hand of those who seek their life. I will give their dead bodies to be food for the birds of the sky and for the animals of the earth.

cases.sentence: Я повергну их мечом перед врагами руками тех, кто хочет их смерти, и отдам их трупы в пищу небесным птицам и ___.
cases.explain: «земным зверям» — the dative marks the indirect object or recipient.
cases.translation: “ ‘ “I will make the counsel of Judah and Jerusalem void in this place. I will cause them to fall by the sword before their enemies, and by the hand of those who seek their life. I will give their dead bodies to be food for the birds of the sky and for the animals of the earth.

cases.sentence: Дома Иерусалима и дворцы царей Иудеи — все дома, где на крышах жгли благовония всему ___ и лили жертвенные возлияния чужим богам, будут осквернены, как место Тофет.
cases.explain: «небесному воинству» — the dative marks the indirect object or recipient.
cases.translation: The houses of Jerusalem, and the houses of the kings of Judah, which are defiled, will be as the place of Topheth, even all the houses on whose roofs they have burned incense to all the army of the sky and have poured out drink offerings to other gods.” ’ ”
